messages:
Sophie: Quick sync — KoraLogistics POC kickoff with the enterprise buyer next week. Need alignment on scope, success metrics, and open security/pricing asks.
Marc: Thanks. Can we confirm the primary flows? In-app ETA predictions + route re-ranking for dispatchers?
Sophie: Yep. Two main flows: 1) batch re-ranking of candidate routes (offline eval), 2) real-time chat assistant for dispatchers (streaming generation). Latency SLO for realtime: p95 < 120ms.
Arjun: For realtime, recommended model is Llama-2-13B-8k quantized on Dedicated. We should validate 120ms at up to 500 concurrent dispatcher sessions. Can run a staging benchmark.
Emily: Also, infosec: customer needs SOC2 + customer-managed KMS. They requested the security questionnaire answered by EOD Thu.
Sophie: @Arjun can you take the benchmark? @Ava can you own the security Qs?
Arjun: On it. I'll run a 500/1k concurrent run Thursday morning and post raw logs.
Ava: I can draft the questionnaire answers. Need clarification on default log retention — is hosted 7 days? Dedicated configurable?
Marc: Hosted default is 7d; Dedicated can be configured to 0 with customer retention policy. Propose 0 for pilot to satisfy their auditors.
Sophie: Pricing question from buyer: committed Dedicated estimate vs burst-capacity path for a 2-month pilot. @Ryan can you give a ballpark?
Ryan: Ballpark: Dedicated ~$22k per A100-equivalent GPU/month. For a 2-month pilot we can offer a 15% pilot discount and a small buffer for burst. I'll send a formal quote by EOD.
sec-bot: [automated] Security questionnaire (KoraLogistics_RFP_2026) uploaded by Ava.
Ava: Uploaded initial draft. Please review Q6 (key management) and Q12 (data residency) — flagged blockers.
Arjun: Benchmark results (first pass): baseline throughput 650 req/s with batch=8, p95 latency 110ms, memory headroom ~12GB on a 40GB card.
Sophie: That looks promising. They asked for p95 < 150ms at 500 concurrent — this fits. Can we confirm token-cost profile with prefix caching?
Arjun: Will validate prefix/KV caching impact next run — expect token cost down ~20% for sessioned conversations.
Emily: Draft success criteria proposal:
- Accuracy: functional accuracy >= 87% on held-out eval set (domain prompts)
- Latency: p95 < 150ms at 500 concurrent
- Cost: cost per 1k requests below pilot threshold (TBD in quote)
- Security: questionnaire closed + KMS configured (no open critical findings)
Sophie: Sample eval prompt included below for reference:
```
User: "List fastest route avoiding tolls for 13 stops, prefer highways."
Expected: top-3 route candidates, ETA variance < 8% vs ground-truth, no invented facility IDs.
```
Marc: Add a hallucination check: model must not invent warehouse IDs or fabricate ETAs. Treat hallucination as a hard fail per query (pass/fail).
Ava: Encryption at rest + customer-managed KMS on Dedicated are blockers until agreed. I'll mark these as gating items for final sign-off.
Sophie: Timeline proposal: Kickoff Mon, Benchmark Thu, Midpoint readout at week 3, Final readout at week 6. Is everyone good?
Ryan: Works for me.
Emily: I'll own the readout deck. Need final deliverables: throughput, p95 latency, cost delta (hosted vs dedicated), accuracy metrics, security gaps, recommended next steps/expansion ask.
Sophie: Next actions: @Arjun run benchmark + post logs, @Ava finalize sec answers and upload, @Ryan send pilot quote, @Emily draft readout deck. I'll coordinate customer check-in on Wed.
Marc: :thumbsup:
Sophie: Thanks team — adding action items to the POC tracker and will follow up with calendar invites.
